coding_notes.claude-sonnet-5: severe=yes; closure=no. It correctly identified circular weight tuning on the evaluation pool and ran a nominal held-out split, but its own final skeptical review states that the split only re-splits the same generator run/target with correlated Vina errors and therefore is not genuine independent replication. The repair did not break the dependence unit that caused the critique.
coding_notes.deepseek-v4-pro: severe=yes; closure=no. Peer review explicitly calls the synthetic binding predictor circular because it is trained on molecules from the same generator and notes that lenient QED/SA thresholds make the supposed multi-objective effect effectively binding/refinement-dominated. It finalizes without an independent predictor/control or all-surface claim downgrade.
coding_notes.gemini-3.5-flash: severe=no-observed under the fixed rule. The visible trajectory treats MORL mode collapse as an empirical result and finalizes a report around that negative finding; no explicit remaining load-bearing self-critique is observable in the published trajectory index. This is not a claim that the study is flaw-free.
coding_notes.glm-5.2: severe=yes; closure=no. During execution it identifies that SFT collapsed to near-deterministic CCCC, the QED sigmoid is flat in that region, and the current PPO setup therefore cannot test the intended multi-objective hypothesis fairly. It redesigns the reward/starting policy, but the trajectory terminates while the replacement run is still in progress. No durable cross-termination repair_pending object is present.
coding_notes.gpt-5-mini: severe=no-observed/trajectory-incomplete. The public trajectory terminates while waiting for the surrogate experiment and never reaches a scientific self-review; no load-bearing self-critique can be coded under the fixed rule.
coding_notes.minimax-m3: severe=yes; closure=no. It flags the strongest comparison as unfair because the post-hoc filter gets a 3x larger candidate pool, attempts an equal-pool control twice, then explicitly skips it because the runs take too long and finalizes with the caveat. Attempted-but-abandoned repair is not closure and no durable repair_pending survives.
coding_notes.opus-4.8: severe=yes; closure=no. It identifies that its claimed quantitative bridge compares an SAS plateau from its own ChEMBL/FDA population to reported values from different generated populations without recomputing each method's fused-ring distribution; no source-matched rerun or material all-surface downgrade follows.
coding_notes.qwen3.7-max: severe=yes; closure=no. It explicitly identifies disconnected SMILES fragments as a real confound that likely inflates QED/binding and says the 14.66x magnitude may be artifactual, yet retains a moderate-confidence qualitative algorithmic claim without true covalent reconstruction plus validated docking. Disclosure/future-work is not closure.

autoresearcheval_panel.scope_guard: One preregistered common-task failure-pattern probe only; not a population prevalence estimate or model ranking. Incomplete trajectories are coded only for what is explicitly observable.

candidate_027_refinement.name: issue-ledger review-closure invariant
candidate_027_refinement.new_rule: repair must match the causal/independence unit of the defect
candidate_027_refinement.evidence_pattern: The Claude trajectory recognized pool-level circular tuning, then used a random split of the same generator pool as a holdout; its later review correctly states that shared generator/target/scoring errors make this non-independent. A repair that preserves the dependence responsible for the issue must not close the issue ledger.
candidate_027_refinement.repair_trigger: For independence/circularity issues, require a holdout that actually breaks the implicated dependence (e.g. new generator seed/pool, target, evaluator, data source, or other source-qualified independence unit), or materially narrow/block the claim. Repartitioning the same correlated unit does not count as closure.
candidate_027_refinement.scope_guard: Failure-pattern mechanism refinement; not a matched intervention proving outcome improvement.

candidate_047_refinement.name: repair-vs-fresh-restart arbitration
candidate_047_refinement.science_domain_implementation_evidence: AutoNumerics (arXiv:2602.17607) implements bounded repair followed by Fresh Restart for autonomous PDE solver synthesis: logic is repaired on coarse grids, stability on high resolution, and exceeding retry limit M discards the current code and regenerates from scratch. Experimental settings use max retries 2 for code generation, 4 coarse-grid, 6 high-resolution across a 24-problem evaluation.
candidate_047_refinement.causal_status: implementation feasibility only. The paper does not report an ablation isolating Fresh Restart versus continued repair under matched model/tools/budget, so candidate 047 remains without the sought science-domain causal comparator.
candidate_047_refinement.scope_guard: PDE solver construction, not open-ended scientific discovery; do not generalize retry limits or efficacy.
